contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ AVRELIVS CAE SAR PII FIL ; R/ TR POT VIIII COS II

Report for H M Coroner. Bottesford (addenda), Lincolnshire. Richard Abdy. 4 AR denarii to AD 207 - see also NLM-ADD973, NLM-ADA762, and NLM-28BC26 (with a fifth, stray coin at NLM-28CBD5). Circumstances of discovery. These addenda were found whilst metal-detecting on a number of occasions between 1997 - 2013. The original find was a Severan denarius hoard ( tpq AD 207) consisting of 165 coins (and eleven pottery sherds from a greyware globular jar). This was published by J. Williams and V. Rigby in CHRB XI, pp.139-146.
